title: ASC rebuild reports stale from pre-write mtime check
content: During v31 reconciliation, build_active_step_context.py computed staleness against the pre-existing ASC mtime before overwriting the ASC. After an AIP edit, the first rebuild therefore wrote staleness_status=stale even though the rendered content already reflected the new AIP; a second rebuild without another AIP edit produced fresh. Evidence: .ai-work/tooling/build_active_step_context.py:264-280 and the attempt-64 STEP-10 rebuild sequence. Consider computing staleness after writing or treating the current rebuild as fresh when source parsing succeeds.

title: Approved DSH Chat Plan is markdown, not structured tasks
content: DSH plan-mode persists the complete approved plan as the JSON `plan` argument of a successful `exit_plan_mode` tool call; the plan-mode projection exposes only active/pending state and no task schema. A deterministic GAT import therefore needs an explicit markdown contract. HUMAN selected `## Tasks` containing checklist/bullet/numbered items, merge-only-missing, with fail-closed approval when no valid tasks exist. Evidence: /home/hoinv/deepseek-harness/packages/plan/plan-mode/src/index.ts:273-348 and ask_user_question responses solo-team/plan-markdown-contract.
